correctness|上一词请求被误记为未回答的提问.title: 上一词请求被误记为未回答的提问
correctness|上一词请求被误记为未回答的提问.why_it_matters: 新支持的正常语音请求“上一词”经 observe_user 时未命中控制短语白名单，被设置为 question 和 answer_pending。随后 previous 可以成功切换当前词，但 question 仍绑定旧词；allow_output 无法匹配当前项目，后续 pause 又以旧 question 项目为 target 返回 context_changed，resume 因 answer_pending 返回 answer_not_drained。一次正常上一词请求会污染后续辅导和恢复流程，通常只能结束任务清除。新提示的“下一词”也未被识别为 child_ack，confirm 会被拒绝。
correctness|上一词请求被误记为未回答的提问.suggested_fix: 把新增的上一词/上一个和下一词请求纳入可信输入分类：上一词作为非提问控制请求处理；下一词与下一个一样设置 child_ack。增加 observe_user 后成功 previous 再提问暂停并恢复的回归用例，确保不会残留 question/answer_pending。

testing|Test privacy revocation during c.title: Test privacy revocation during cloud streaming
testing|Test privacy revocation during c.why_it_matters: The new stream checks privacy after each response line, but the only privacy test starts with permission already denied. A regression that removes the in-stream check could continue receiving and storing a child's dictated text/audio after privacy is enabled while the request is active, and the suite would still pass.
testing|Test privacy revocation during c.suggested_fix: Add a mock streaming response that yields one valid PCM chunk, flips allowed to false before the next chunk, then asserts synthesis raises the revocation error and yields no completed asset. Keep the existing pre-request denial test.

testing|Test manual controls during acti.title: Test manual controls during active playback
testing|Test manual controls during acti.why_it_matters: The engine newly accepts previous, confirm, and replay while manual audio is playing, where it must stop the old sound and fence its late completion callback. The navigation test drains every sound before issuing these commands, so an early remote press could play two words or move the cursor after a late callback without failing the suite.
testing|Test manual controls during acti.suggested_fix: Extend the native manual test to issue previous, confirm, and replay before sound.drain(), then invoke each captured old completion callback and assert the cursor, state, and actual_repeats stay on the newly selected item; also assert the old sound was stopped.

agent-native|Expose the bound manual mod.title: Expose the bound manual mode to the agent
agent-native|Expose the bound manual mod.why_it_matters: The new instructions depend on manual_navigation, but subsequent dialogue turns receive only the skill text and a status tool result without the task playback settings. After preparation or task adoption, the agent cannot reliably know whether to apply manual-mode navigation instructions to the bound task.
agent-native|Expose the bound manual mod.suggested_fix: Add the bound task's pinned playback settings, including manual_navigation, to model_instructions and the dialogue agent's system context; include the same setting in get_dictation_task_status so the agent can refresh it after adoption. Read from the task snapshot, not the latest configuration revision.

agent-native|Allow spoken next during ma.title: Allow spoken next during manual playback
agent-native|Allow spoken next during ma.why_it_matters: The remote's right key advances while a manual word is still playing, but a child saying '下一词' at that point cannot do the same: observe_user only records child_ack in waiting_child, so the agent's confirm tool returns child_confirmation_required even if playback has finished by the time it calls the tool. The child must repeat the request.
agent-native|Allow spoken next during ma.suggested_fix: For bound tasks with manual_navigation enabled, accept an explicit next-word utterance while the current dictation item is playing. Bind the acknowledgement to the task and item identity and permit confirm after the audio completes or while it plays, while preserving the pending-answer and explanation gates.

api-contract|Pinned Vivi voice settings.title: Pinned Vivi voice settings remain mutable
api-contract|Pinned Vivi voice settings.why_it_matters: The requested Vivi preset is a fixed task contract, but the config API accepts any valid speaker, pitch, rate, volume, and instruction. A saved config can therefore produce a task with a different voice or reading behavior while still being labeled as the pinned Doubao Vivi option; the UI exposes those changes directly.
api-contract|Pinned Vivi voice settings.suggested_fix: Assuming 'pinned' means the specified values must be immutable, make validate_tts require equality with DEFAULT_TTS for every field and show those values as read-only in the UI. Keep the optional tts field itself so older local-TTS configs remain valid.
